title: Belt, Montana truck driver sees light land in ravine

tellings.quote: a truck driver was driving through the town of Belt, Montana, which was about [gasps] 35 miles to the southeast
A local truck driver in Montana and police officer are also on record having seen the UFO in the area.
tellings.difference: Adds a police officer as a second witness and leaves out the light landing in a ravine.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the 1967 sighting by a local truck driver near Malmstrom, told elsewhere as the Belt truck driver.

as_told.title: Montana truck driver and police officer see the UFO
as_told.place_text: near Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer who says a UFO once shut down nuclear missiles he was guarding, tells a side story he credits to a man named Lewis Chase. According to Salas, around March 24, 1967, a truck driver passing through the small town of Belt, Montana, about 35 miles southeast of the area he was describing, saw a light come down and land in a ravine. Told alongside the missile story, it would mean the strange lights were seen by ordinary people nearby too, not only by the military.
